note: Run by the volunteers of the Gold Springs Park Society on Gold Springs Lake, a stocked oxbow reservoir beside the Milk River about 10 km north of the US border; one camping area fills the peninsula inside the oxbow. Rental cabins, playground, two water slides, swimming beaches, paddle boat and canoe rentals, fish cleaning station and canoe access to the Milk River. No off-highway vehicles. --Claude

PHONE MISSING: stored phone is empty; the society's pages ('Reservations by phone: Telephone: 403-647-2277', 'Phone 1-403-647-2277') and Google (+1 403-647-2277) give 403-647-2277 - recommend adding it.

PRESENCE / PRICE (private): Google Maps 'Gold Springs Park Campground' 4.5 from 233 reviews, phone +1 403-647-2277 - presence passes on Google even with the website down. Posted rate C$30-35 (2025 page, same text live 2026-10-16); RV Life 4.5 / $$ (stored). Under C$69.
OWNERSHIP: 'Operator is: The Volunteers of the Gold Springs Park Society' - a non-profit society, so private is right.

LONG STAY: no seasonal, monthly or weekly rates are offered on any page read; reservations by phone for the season. Imagery (summer) shows the peninsula densely filled with trailers, some looking long-parked, but no page or review read says sites are seasonal - no evidence of a long-stay park; tests 1-5 pass on what was read.

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - confirmed for some sites): Gold Springs Lake is an oxbow of roughly 8 ha (crescent ~1 km long, 60-100 m wide on imagery), so a lake, not a pond. On the peninsula inside the oxbow the RV units at its west tip and along its south and north edges sit about 10-30 m from the water with open grass between (a few shrubs); the mainland north loop's units are ~30-40 m from the lake behind a row of trees. Lakefront holds for the peninsula sites; site numbers are not on any page read (the PDF map link on Wayback came back empty).

PIN (49.09728,-111.99093): matches the society's 'GPS: 49.09727, -111.99107', at the east end of the mainland loop near the office; the peninsula sites centre ~49.0960,-111.9938 (~240 m SW). Overall centroid within ~150 m of the pin; no move needed.
